[[Vinyor Tesh]] had a '''father''' who was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] researcher working on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. During the [[Devastation of Manaan]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] along with his [[Vinyor Tesh's mother|partner]] by the invading [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] forces. His young son was saved by a visiting [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] named [[Laotah]], who took the child to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to be [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] at the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vinyor Tesh's father was mentioned in the Codex entry for Master Vinyor Tesh in the [[2019]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught|''Onslaught'']] to the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by the company [[BioWare]].<ref name="Codex" />
